tier_policy.source: Panel 2026-08-17, kimi.ai seat, reaffirmed by Graham.
tier_policy.1: Public artifact: repo, paper, patent, press release. May be asserted as an accomplishment in any channel.
tier_policy.2: Attested history: employment record, self-reported scope. Resume may carry it only as 'experience with <domain>' or 'background in <area>' - never with a leadership verb, a metric, or deliverable language. Outreach may reference it to establish relevance. Interview may probe it.
tier_policy.3: Inferred competence from an adjacent skill. Interview probing only; never asserted.
tier_policy.firewall: No single wording may name a repository and a program or agency together, because a reader infers the repository was a contract deliverable.
